title: GitHub Copilot assisted permissions generally available
author: Allison
description: Assisted permissions are now generally available in GitHub Copilot CLI, GitHub Copilot app, and Visual Studio Code. When Copilot requests permission to run a command, access a file system path,… The post GitHub Copilot assisted permissions generally available appeared first on The GitHub Blog .
summary: Assisted permissions are now generally available in GitHub Copilot CLI, GitHub Copilot app, and Visual Studio Code. When Copilot requests permission to run a command, access a file system path, or open a URL, a large language model evaluates the request.
takeaways: When Copilot requests permission to run a command, access a file system path, or open a URL, a large language model evaluates the request.
GitHub Copilot app Open the mode picker, click Tool permissions , then select Assisted .
GitHub Copilot CLI Run /permissions , then select assisted .
